content.short: The HashGuardians universe is a 2D gaming metaverse, with passive income and play to earn features.
content.description:
The HashGuardians universe is a 2D gaming metaverse based on the Cardano blockchain. There are 10,000 unique HashGuardian NFT´s to collect which will be the only entry to the HashGuardians universe in the first step. Each HashGuardian is an on-chain minted NFT that is only owned by you. Different species with randomized gadgets are waiting for you. All HashGuardian owners are authorized to join upcoming pre-sales. They are also able to claim free HashCoins every month.

The HashBox is the item and lootbox in the upcoming HashGuardians universe. There will be different versions of it some for purchase and some free to claim for HashGuardians holders. These HashBoxes and the content can be sold or traded by the owner on secondary markets. For example, a "Special Edition" or Legendary HashBox will be much more limited than more common ones. Also very rare and legendary assets will apply inside every HashBox which will only be available in that specific HashBox. Opened HashBoxes will be burned and never be available on the market again.

HashCoins are the staking rewards for HashGuardian holders and will be the in-game currency in the future HashGuardians game. To reward loyal HashGuardian holders we are creating a reward system around the HashGuardians universe. Every HashGuardians holder will get 100 HashCoins per month on a fixed date for every HashGuardian in his wallet.
